title: Yêu cầu approval trước khi commit
goal: Bắt buộc trình bày thay đổi và commit message đề xuất, sau đó chờ người dùng approve rõ ràng trước mỗi commit; phát hành patch 0.6.4.
nonGoals: Tự động stage hoặc commit thay đổi hiện tại.
Thay đổi branch, push, PR hoặc release workflow khác.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Current, canonical, generated, and finish-work instructions require showing changes and a proposed commit message, then waiting for explicit approval before commit.

validationPlan.description: Run template tests and inspect the commit-approval instructions.
Run typecheck, lint, package check, and diff check.
validationPlan.command: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm pack:check && git diff --check

evidence.summary: New generated AGENTS and workflow assertions failed as expected because the commit-approval rule was absent.

Generated template and skill-source tests (4 tests), typecheck, lint, package check, and diff check passed. Current/canonical/generated instructions require showing changes and a proposed commit message, then explicit approval before staging or committing; package metadata is 0.6.4.
